About us

A taste that takes you home

Remember the smell of something sweet baking in the kitchen? The excitement of Sweet Potato Pudding fresh from the oven, Fruit Cake at Christmas, or stopping for a Gizzada or Coconut Drops as a little treat?

Those weren't just flavours. They were memories of home.

At Yaad Bites, we bring those memories back through the Jamaican treats we grew up knowing and loving. Every bite is inspired by the warmth, flavour and traditions of Jamaica.

Because no matter where life takes you, sometimes one familiar taste is all it takes to bring you back to family, laughter, simpler days and Yaad.

Company information

Yaad Bites is a Jamaican food company specializing in traditional Jamaican baked goods and sweet treats. The company is dedicated to preserving and sharing the authentic flavours of Jamaica through products that reflect the country's rich culinary heritage.

Our product line includes Jamaican Coconut Cake, Sweet Potato Pudding, Jamaican Fruit Cake, Coconut Drops, Gizzada and Banana Bread. Each product is prepared with a focus on quality, flavour, consistency, love and authenticity.

Yaad Bites aims to establish itself as a trusted Jamaican brand that connects customers with the familiar tastes of home while introducing traditional Jamaican treats to new generations and markets.

Purpose of Yaad Bites

Yaad Bites is a Jamaican-inspired bakery created to provide customers with delicious, high quality baked goods that promote the flavours and culture of Jamaica. The company aims to combine traditional Jamaican treats with a modern and simple customer experience. Yaad Bites represents the idea that food can connect people to their culture, memories, and the overall sense of the Caribbean.

Our mission

Yaad Bites is committed to creating fresh, delicious Jamaican baked goods that celebrate the authentic flavors and traditions of Jamaica while providing quality products and excellent customer service.

Our vision

To become a trusted Jamaican bakery known for authentic flavors, quality baked goods, creative offerings, and exceptional customer experiences.

Our core values

Quality

We are committed to using quality ingredients and providing fresh, delicious products.

Customer Satisfaction

We strive to make every customer's experience enjoyable and memorable.

Creativity

We bring fresh and innovative ideas to Jamaican baked goods.

Integrity

We operate with honesty, responsibility, and respect.

Business goals

Short-term goals

Provide high-quality products

Yaad Bites will maintain consistent quality in its baked goods by using suitable ingredients and ensuring that products are prepared and presented properly.

Build a strong online presence

The company will use its website and social media platforms to promote its products, connect with customers, and increase brand awareness.

Increase customer satisfaction

Yaad Bites will focus on providing friendly customer service, reliable ordering, attractive product presentation, and quality products that encourage customers to return.

Long-term goals

Expand the product range

Yaad Bites plans to introduce additional Jamaican-inspired baked goods and new products based on customer preferences and market demand.

Expand delivery and reach

As the business grows, Yaad Bites aims to improve and expand its delivery services so that more customers across Jamaica can access its products.

CEO's welcome

Welcome to Yaad Bites! I started this bakery because I wanted everyone to taste the Jamaican baking I grew up with. Every spice bun, gizzada and toto we make is baked with care, real ingredients and a lot of pride. Thank you for choosing us, and we hope every bite feels like home.

As the CEO of Yaad Bites, I am proud to welcome you to a bakery built around one simple idea: bringing a taste of Jamaica to every bite.

Yaad Bites was created to celebrate the authentic flavours and traditions of Jamaica while offering fresh, delicious baked goods for everyone to enjoy. From our classic spice bun and bulla cake to our gizzada, coconut drops, toto, and sweet potato pudding, our menu is inspired by the traditional treats that make Jamaican food so special.

Our commitment goes beyond the products we offer. We believe in quality, customer satisfaction, having that touch of creativity, and integrity. These values guide how we develop our products, serve our customers, and overall work together as a team.

This project represents the hard work, creativity, and teamwork of all nine members of our group. Each person has played an important role in bringing the Yaad Bites vision to life, from developing our brand and products to creating our website and marketing experience.

We invite you to explore our website, discover our menu, and most importantly, experience a taste of yard in every bite.

Welcome to Yaad Bites where Jamaican tradition meets fresh, delicious goodness.

Marcia Campbell, Founder and CEO

Leadership

Role of the CEO

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is responsible for providing overall leadership and direction for Yaad Bites. The CEO coordinates the different areas of the business and ensures that each team member understands their responsibilities and contributes toward the company's objectives.

As CEO, my responsibility is to ensure that Yaad Bites remains focused on its mission and vision while maintaining high standards of quality and customer service. This includes communicating with team members, monitoring progress, helping with decision-making, and ensuring our overall business development.

The CEO also plays an important role in the company's growth by identifying opportunities and making sure that business decisions support the long-term goals of Yaad Bites. Overall, the aim is to ensure Yaad Bites becomes an effective and memorable brand.

Executive summary

Our business

Yaad Bites is a Jamaican bakery that specializes in freshly baked, traditional treats made with authentic island flavours. Our products include spice bun, bulla cake, gizzada, coconut drops, toto, and sweet potato pudding. Each item is prepared in small batches using quality ingredients such as coconut, ginger, and nutmeg to capture the true taste of Jamaica.

Our customers & goal

Our bakery caters to Jamaican families, students, office workers, and tourists who enjoy traditional Jamaican baked goods. Our main goal is to preserve traditions while offering customers delicious products, affordable prices, and excellent customer service.

What makes us unique

What makes Yaad Bites unique is the way we combine traditional recipes with modern ideas. While we maintain the authentic flavours that Jamaicans know and love, we also introduce creative twists to keep our products exciting. Customers can conveniently browse our online menu, view nutritional information, read customer reviews, and place an order for pickup and delivery.

Our marketing

We promote our bakery through social media, flyers, word of mouth, and participate in community events. Our brand colours, red, green, gold, and cream, represent the warmth, creativity, and Jamaican pride behind our business.

Our vision

Overall, Yaad Bites is more than just a bakery; it is a celebration of Jamaican culture and tradition. We are committed to providing quality baked goods, friendly service, and a memorable experience while bringing the authentic taste of yaad to every customer.

Yaad Bites Jamaican Spice Bun

Sweet, spiced and authentically Jamaican.

A rich, moist Jamaican spice bun made with warm island spices, molasses, dried fruit and glacé cherries. Baked to a deep brown colour with a soft, flavourful crumb, this traditional favourite offers a balanced combination of sweetness, spice and fruit in every slice. Enjoy it on its own or pair it with Jamaican cheddar cheese for the classic bun-and-cheese experience.

Net weight: Approx. 450 gServing size: 1 slice (55 to 60 g)Servings: Approx. 8 slices per loaf

Ingredients and allergens

Ingredients: Wheat flour, brown sugar, malt beverage or stout, molasses, margarine or butter, raisins, glacé cherries, mixed peel, vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, mixed spice, baking powder, baking soda, Jamaican browning and salt.

⚠ Allergen information
Contains: WHEAT / GLUTEN.
May contain: MILK, EGG, PEANUTS and TREE NUTS if handled on shared equipment.

Storage: Keep sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and excessive heat.

J$750 per loafNutrition
0

Yaad Bites Jamaican Bulla Cake

Traditional Jamaican goodness in every bite.

A traditional Jamaican bulla cake with a firm yet tender texture and a warm ginger-spice flavour. Made with brown sugar, molasses and aromatic spices, Yaad Bites Bulla Cake is simple, satisfying and unmistakably Jamaican. It is ideal as a quick snack and pairs especially well with cheese, avocado, butter or a warm beverage.

Net weight: Approx. 90 gServing size: 1 bullaServings: 1

Ingredients and allergens

Ingredients: Wheat flour, brown sugar, molasses, water, margarine or butter, ground ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla extract, baking powder, baking soda, Jamaican browning and salt.

⚠ Allergen information
Contains: WHEAT / GLUTEN.
May contain: MILK, EGG, PEANUTS and TREE NUTS if handled on shared equipment.

Storage: Keep sealed in a cool, dry place. Avoid exposure to moisture and direct sunlight.

J$200 each, 2 for J$350Nutrition
0

Yaad Bites Coconut Gizzada

Crispy pastry. Sweet coconut. Pure Jamaican tradition.

A traditional Jamaican coconut tart featuring a crisp, golden pastry shell filled with sweet, spiced coconut. Fresh grated coconut is gently cooked with brown sugar, ginger and aromatic spices before being baked in a distinctive pinched pastry crust. The result is a satisfying combination of crisp pastry and chewy, caramelised coconut.

Net weight: Approx. 70 to 75 gServing size: 1 gizzadaServings: 1

Ingredients and allergens

Ingredients: Wheat flour, margarine or butter, fresh grated coconut, brown sugar, water, vanilla extract, ground ginger, nutmeg, cinnamon, Jamaican browning, salt and sugar for the pastry as required.

⚠ Allergen information
Contains: WHEAT / GLUTEN, COCONUT.

Storage: Store in sealed food-safe packaging in a cool, dry place.

J$250 eachNutrition
0

Yaad Bites Coconut Drops

Chewy, ginger-spiced, island snack.

A chewy, caramelized Jamaican coconut drop made with freshly grated coconut, dark brown sugar, fresh ginger and vanilla. Slow-cooked to a sticky, sweet finish with a deep island flavour in every bite.

Net weight: Approx. 90 gServing size: 1 pack (3 drops, 90 g)Servings: Approx. 1

Ingredients and allergens

Ingredients: Freshly grated coconut, dark brown sugar, fresh ginger (grated), water, vanilla extract, salt, mixed spice.

⚠ Allergen information
Contains: COCONUT.

Yaad Bites Toto

Moist, coconutty, lightly spiced.

An authentic Jamaican toto: a dense, buttery coconut cake made with grated coconut, rich coconut milk, brown sugar, nutmeg and cinnamon. Baked golden with a soft, moist crumb and slightly crisp top. Best served slightly warmed.

Net weight: Approx. 120 gServing size: 1 slice (120 g), 1/8 of cakeServings: Approx. 8 per cake

Ingredients and allergens

Ingredients: All-purpose flour, freshly grated coconut, coconut milk, brown sugar, margarine / butter, baking powder, vanilla extract, nutmeg, cinnamon, salt.

⚠ Allergen information
Contains: WHEAT / GLUTEN, COCONUT, MILK (if made with butter).
J$350 per sliceNutrition
0

Yaad Bites Sweet Potato Pudding

Rich, dense, a classic Yaad favourite.

A rich, dense Jamaican sweet potato pudding made with grated sweet potato, creamy coconut milk, raisins and warm island spices. Slow-baked with our signature soft totta layer at the bottom for a moist, hearty finish.

Net weight: Approx. 150 gServing size: 1 slice (150 g), 1/10 of panServings: Approx. 10 per pan

Ingredients and allergens

Ingredients: Jamaican sweet potato (grated), coconut milk, brown sugar, all-purpose flour, cornmeal, raisins, vanilla extract, nutmeg, cinnamon, mixed spice, salt, butter, water for totta.

⚠ Allergen information
Contains: WHEAT / GLUTEN, COCONUT, MILK.
